title: Canonical ordinary constant-tower direct-image square
statement: For an abelian category $\mathcal A$ with a monoidal structure and a category $\mathcal B$, a functor $F:\mathcal A\to\mathcal B$, and the ordinary strict sequence and termwise postcomposition constructions [def-sf-strict-tensor-reduction-termwise], define the constant-tower square $\Delta_{\mathcal A}\,F^{\mathbf N^{op}}\cong F\,\Delta_{\mathcal B}$ by its component at $M$: both diagrams have value $F(M)$ and identity transition maps, and every component of the comparison is $1_{F(M)}$. This is the ordinary natural isomorphism, before localization; no derived existence or comparison theorem is asserted.

source.place: Ordinary functor categories: constant diagrams commute with postcomposition; applied in the strict localization obligation.
